exposure: fetal station in the first stage of labor
cohort: The study included 8,123 women with nonanomalous singletons who presented in spontaneous labor with intact membranes to an Obstetric Triage Unit between January 1, 2012, and August 31, 2016.
finding: Advanced fetal station in the first stage of labor was significantly associated with differing rates of labor progression, and a positive fetal station was significantly less likely to result in cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: A positive fetal station at initial exam was significantly less likely to result in cesarean delivery.
